title: Meals You Can’t Miss

chapters.dish: Rice with jackfruit, beetroot & chicken curries

editorial: Sri Lankan rice and curry was our staple meal, and that is not a complaint thanks to the variety of curries on offer. Sri Lankan meals are pretty balanced, but if you feel like it’s light on protein, you can always order an extra meat dish.

Our best breakfast was at Bentota Cake House in Dambulla, where we relished kiribath, pol sambhol, egg hoppers and chicken curry. For the quintessential Sri Lankan breakfast, try the hoppers and sambol.

A typical lunch will have rice accompanied by a 2-4 vegetable and meat curries. Matey Hut was our mainstay in Ella, as is the case for many tourists. The jackfruit curry here is delectable! Be prepared for long lines during peak lunch and dinner times.

For dinner, we chose to eat lighter. Rice with a single curry rather the elaborate spreads we devoured for lunch. In Mirissa, we had wonderful fish and prawn (shrimp) curries at the unassuming Twin Brothers seafood hut.
